# Open Thread 458

**Date:** 2026-11-02T05:04:37.000Z

---

View this post on the web at https://www.astralcodexten.com/p/open-thread-458

This is the weekly visible open thread. Post about anything you want, ask random questions, whatever. ACX has an unofficial subreddit [ https://substack.com/redirect/8a56dbd6-06ef-45a0-9c6f-9c613907e27a?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ], Discord [ https://substack.com/redirect/f085db8b-095f-46b8-849f-2f3b8771112f?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ], and bulletin board [ https://substack.com/redirect/15904888-99e2-4c76-bd11-fa3da04b1c23?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ], and in-person meetups around the world [ https://substack.com/redirect/ac7a14b4-414d-4509-81eb-e932b5001a96?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ]. Most content is free, some is subscriber only; you can subscribe here [ https://substack.com/redirect/07128b6b-ff31-40fa-aac6-7df4964f3d9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ]. Also:
1: Thanks to everyone who offered additional considerations on my California ballot. And David Bloomin has collected a list of good Bay Area voting guides on OpenBallot.app [ https://substack.com/redirect/a4ce1f0c-a11e-4132-831e-fc6bc4233051?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ], so you can see where I agree and disagree with everyone else, including SF Dems, SF Republicans, YIMBYs, Women, and the “SF League Of Pissed Of Voters”.
2: One of the leading AI superforecaster companies, FutureSearch, is hiring. Many of them are ACX readers, and anyone with a sincere interest in forecasting would fit in well there. See available positions here [ https://substack.com/redirect/81ebd35d-99dd-40f3-9599-991b7a9e850f?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ].
3: Pause AI protest in London on November 21, they have 829 people and are going for at least 1,000. Go here [ https://substack.com/redirect/b41ca15f-a360-4bc3-9960-7302307da193?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ] to learn more, sign up, and get information on additional volunteer opportunities.
4: Meetups update: Manila, Philippines, is now on the list [ https://substack.com/redirect/a33d5da7-9bd1-4209-acbe-ee78f66fd3ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMXlnZjcifQ.KOUIeBfeCRzhIwFnKXyQigR4j0VpF-SZzascYhSZunw ].
5: It’s always exciting when one of my posts makes it big enough to become someone’s Halloween costume:
